title: Composite Risk Signals Matrix — Renewal Readiness Lens (draft)
content:
Purpose
This working doc defines a composite scoring approach (three sub-scores + velocity) to surface renewal risk and operationalize signal-driven playbooks. Focus: actionable flags that map directly to 1) outreach priority, 2) play type, and 3) technical remediation requests.

Summary of approach (high-level)
- Build three sub-scores: Usage Health (UH), Engagement Health (EH), Financial/Contract Health (FH).
- Compute a Weighted Composite Risk (WCR): WCR = w1*(1-UH) + w2*(1-EH) + w3*(1-FH) + w4*VelocityPenalty. Values normalized to 0..1 (higher = more at-risk).
- Maintain a short list of explicit risk flags (binary) for immediate triage: SLA_breach_window, regression_alert, feature_drop, billing_lag.
- Surface top-3 contributing signals per account in CS UI for faster diagnostics.

Signal taxonomy (examples & rationale)
1) Usage Health signals (what customers actually use)
  - active_days_30d: fraction of days with any request in last 30d (SQL: sum(requests>0)/30).
  - avg_prefix_cache_hit_rate: prefix cache hits / total requests. Low -> cost/latency pain.
  - mean_session_depth: median of tokens-per-session (identifies adoption depth).
  - feature_toggle_pct: % of sessions using new key features (e.g., structured-output, function-calls).
  - alert: prefix_cache_hit_rate < 0.10 AND avg_batch_tokens < 6 -> possible under-utilization or mis-instrumentation.

2) Engagement Health signals (people & workflows)
  - active_seats_count: distinct active API keys / seats over 90d window.
  - key_user_churn_rate: % of previously-active users who dropped off in 60d.
  - support_volume_per_1000_requests: normalized support contacts (rising -> friction).
  - org_sentiment_index: aggregated CS notes sentiment (nlp) on last 3 tickets.
  - alert: active_seats_count drop >=25% quarter-over-quarter -> high touch required.

3) Financial/Contract Health signals
  - committed_utilization_pct: usage / committed_capacity. Under-utilized or overage risk.
  - invoice_dispute_flag: true if billing ticket open >14d.
  - incremental_spend_trend: 3mo slope of spend. Negative slope + high fixed commitment -> churn risk.
  - alert: invoice_dispute_flag == true AND committed_utilization_pct < 40% -> prioritize commercial outreach.

4) Quality/Regression and Eval signals (model-output related)
  - eval_regression_count: number of prompt-eval regressions triggered in last 30d (from Redwood Optimize).
  - downstream-error-rate: rate of parsing/validation failures in customer's pipelines.
  - human-in-the-loop-reversions: fraction of responses manually corrected.

Signal normalization notes
- Continuous signals normalized per-account to 0..1 using robust percentiles (5th/95th) to reduce outlier skew.
- For volume-inflated signals (requests), use per-seat or per-committed-unit denominators.

Weighting & example defaults (tuning candidate, not final)
- UH weight w1 = 0.45
- EH weight w2 = 0.30
- FH weight w3 = 0.20
- Velocity penalty w4 = 0.05 (captures rapid negative deltas)
- VelocityPenalty := min(1, max(0, recent_delta_norm * 2)) where recent_delta_norm is normalized 0..0.5 range for a big hit.

Computational example (pseudo-SQL + math)
- Compute UH: UH = 0.4*norm(active_days_30d) + 0.3*norm(mean_session_depth) + 0.3*norm(avg_prefix_cache_hit_rate)
- Compute EH: EH = 0.5*norm(active_seats_count) + 0.3*(1 - norm(key_user_churn_rate)) + 0.2*norm(org_sentiment_index)
- Compute FH: FH = 0.6*norm(committed_utilization_pct) + 0.4*(1 - norm(invoice_dispute_lag_days))
- Example SQL snippet for active_days_30d (BigQuery style):
  SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN request_count>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/30.0 AS active_days_30d
  FROM telemetry.requests_daily
  WHERE event_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE()
  GROUP BY account_id;

Risk tiers and recommended plays (automations + human ops)
- WCR < 0.15: Green — Low touch (auto NPS survey + quarterly check-in).
- 0.15 <= WCR < 0.40: Amber — Targeted play: outreach from CSM, product tips, onboarding nudges.
- 0.40 <= WCR < 0.70: Red — Escalation: schedule RTM, run focused health review, create remediation tickets (infra/engineering).
- WCR >= 0.70: Critical — Executive outreach, renewal contingency planning, consider offering migration assistance or commercial concessions.

Top contributing signals mapping to playbook actions (examples)
- Low prefix_cache_hit_rate -> Engineering: review caching keys & prompt patterns; Product: recommend batching or canonical prompts.
- High eval_regression_count -> Research/Applied ML: prioritized model backtest + rollback plan.
- Invoice_dispute_flag -> Sales/Finance: pause automated renewals and open dispute resolution runway.
- Active_seats_count drop -> CSM: conduct user interviews, win-back campaigns.

Operational considerations + implementation checklist (MVP scope)
- Data sources: telemetry.requests_daily (usage), billing.invoices (finance), support.tickets (engagement), optimize.evals (quality).
- Cron cadence: daily compute and push to CS dashboard (delta alerts every 6 hours for Velocity).
- UI: show WCR, top-3 signals, last 90d sparklines, and suggested next action.
- Alerting: automated Slack triage for accounts above 0.60 with at least one binary risk flag.
- Backfills: run 12 months backfill to calibrate normalization and percentiles.

Open questions / unresolved items (for group review)
- Should committed_utilization be treated as inverted risk for small prepay customers? (small customers with low commit may be fine)
- What is the right cadence for velocity sensitivity so we don’t over-alert on short experiments?
- Which signals should be pre-aggregated per-seat vs per-organization?

Next steps (short runway)
- [Avery] Wire up active_days_30d and avg_prefix_cache_hit_rate queries against staging telemetry (by 2026-02-28).
- [Marcus] Prototype WCR dashboard card in Looker/Metabase (by 2026-03-07).
- [Roxanne] Draft playbook templates for Amber and Red tiers (by 2026-03-10).

Notes to reviewers
- This is intentionally prescriptive — we want signals to map 1:1 to play types. Please add comments inline where you think a signal should be dropped or a weight rebalanced.
- If you have concrete SQL or Looker explores, paste links in linked_artifacts.

Appendix: quick reference of sample thresholds (MVP)
- prefix_cache_hit_rate: low if <0.15, medium 0.15-0.40, high >0.40
- active_days_30d: low <4, medium 4-18, high >18
- committed_utilization_pct: under-utilized <40%, healthy 40-80%, overage >80%
- eval_regression_count: >3 in 30d -> raise quality flag

Document history
- 2025-11-03: initial draft (Avery)
- 2025-12-15: added velocity penalty and example SQL (Marcus)
- 2026-02-20: normalized signals & operational checklist updated (Roxanne)

Quick links
- Confluence: renewal-telemetry-v1 (see linked_artifacts)
- Related GH: cs-signal-examples PR #27

(End of draft)
